title: FP8 golden-seed evaluation and rollback automation for Hopper E4M3/E5M2 activation
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Enable FP8 (E4M3/E5M2) quantization profiles on Hopper GPUs with a deterministic evaluation harness and automated rollback controls. This ticket delivers: (1) a 'golden-seed' synthetic and real-prompt evaluation suite that produces reproducible regression signals across seeds and batch shapes; (2) CI/Canary gating that ties telemetry to automatic rollback actions when accuracy regressions or distributional drift exceed thresholds; (3) an authorable policy for switching between E4M3, E5M2, INT8, and FP16 fallbacks; and (4) observability dashboards and runbooks for on-call. Goal is to safely flip-on FP8 for supported models with minimal manual intervention and clear audit trails.
technical_approach: 1) Build a deterministic golden-seed eval harness: fixed RNG seeds, canonical prompt sets (few-shot QA, summarization, code completion, embeddings similarity), and synthetic noise perturbations to stress calibration. 2) Calibration snapshots: capture per-layer scale/offset artifacts at multiple temperature/sequence-length points and store as signed artifacts in the calibration registry. 3) Shadow-canary pipeline: route 5-10% of production-like traffic to FP8 variants in shadow mode; compute token-level KL, logprob delta, and task metrics (QA F1, rouge-l, embedding cosine delta). 4) Gate-and-rollback automation: define gating rules (e.g., mean embedding cosine < 0.985 or QA F1 drop > 1.5 pts triggers auto-revert) implemented as a webhook to the deployment controller that can perform fast switchback to a pinned fallback. 5) CI integration: add golden-seed eval to PR checks for quantization changes and to nightly convergence runs. 6) Add canary telemetry + alerts to Console: aggregated per-model and per-client.
validation_plan: - Unit tests for calibration snapshot serialization and deserialization. - Golden-seed regression suite: run on candidate FP8 builds and compare against baseline FP16/INT8 across seeds (n=5) and batch sizes {1,8,64}. - Task-level thresholds: summarization ROUGE-L delta <= 0.8, code-completion exact-match delta <= 1.0, QA F1 delta <= 1.5, mean embedding cosine >= 0.985. - Stability stress runs: 24h high-throughput runs to detect activation instability or divergence in KV cache behavior. - Manual human-in-the-loop review for any model failing thresholds before broad rollout. - Post-rollout shadow divergence monitoring for 14 days with automated weekly report.
telemetry: Emit the following metrics tagged by model, profile, seq_len_bucket, client_id: token_logprob_delta, token_kl_estimate, avg_embedding_cosine, task_metric_delta (per-task), p99_latency, error_rate, memory_headroom. Log calibration snapshot version and seed hashes for each run. In Console add per-profile dashboards and a regression alert that triggers on sustained metric violations for 10 minutes or more.
rollout_plan: Phase 0: Internal integration and CI gating (this ticket). Phase 1: Shadow canaries (5% of traffic) for 48-72h with active monitoring. Phase 2: Gradual ramp (5 -> 25 -> 50%) with 24h holds and telemetry review at each step. Phase 3: Broad enablement with 7-day drift watch. Emergency rollback is automated on gate violation; manual rollback requires oncall approval and postmortem. Provide a controlled opt-out for named enterprise customers.
qa_checklist: Add golden-seed suite to CI and nightly pipelines
Store calibration snapshots in calibration-registry with versioning and KMS encryption
Implement webhook-based rollback action in deployment controller
Create Console dashboards for per-profile regression metrics
Run 24h stability stress test with KV cache enabled
Run human eval on 200 sampled prompts for each model that passes thresholds
Document runbook steps and incident playbook in Confluence
Add regression alert hooks to PagerDuty escalation policy
success_criteria: FP8-enabled candidate builds pass golden-seed regression across all seed runs and batch sizes; automated canary rollback triggers and performs correctly in at least 2 simulated failure scenarios; no customer-facing regressions observed on 7-day post-rollout watch for canaried customers; Console shows clear per-profile telemetry and at least one enterprise customer opts in to FP8 without support escalation.
risks: Undetected long-tail failure modes due to small evaluation set
FP8 numerical instability on rare per-layer activations leading to generation drift
KV cache interactions causing non-deterministic behavior across sequence lengths
Automated rollback flapping if thresholds set too aggressively
Compliance audit overhead for storing calibration artifacts (ensure KMS/HSM controls)
timeline: Weeks 1-2: implement golden-seed harness, calibration snapshot format, CI integration. Week 3: Console dashboards and webhook rollback implementation. Week 4: Shadow canaries and 24h stress runs. Week 5: Gradual ramp and enterprise opt-ins. Week 6: Post-rollout watch and retrospective.
